newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases in line with crude futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases in line with crude futures.

text.p: NWE naphtha eased slightly in line with crude futures on Tuesday, although some traders noted the fall was not exerting as much pressure as they had expected.
"The market seem in two minds on whether to follow crude or ignore the falls," said one trader. "The correlation between crude and naphtha hasn't been too strong recently."
Swaps were assessed around $188/$188.50 for May paper, $190.50/$191.50 cif NWE for June and $191.50/$192 for July, traders said.
"It's off a bit in line with crude but not that much," another trader said.
The physical side, was fairly quiet following the public holiday across most of Europe on Monday.
